Fit an FFBS-based dynamic emulator

Source: R/func_wrapper.R
emulator_learn.Rd

Fits an episode-based emulator to saved simulator runs. The default inverse-Wishart model is retained for compatibility. Use covariance = "sigma2R" for scalar-variance coefficient samples that can be passed to calibration_prepare().

Usage

emulator_learn(
  pde_para_train,
  dt_pde_train,
  Nx,
  Ny,
  F_ls_train = "default",
  F_ls_test = "default",
  N_people = 10000,
  nsam = 10,
  AR_choice = 2,
  episode_window = 1,
  gp_tune = 0.5,
  gp_sigma2 = 1.1,
  gp_tau2 = 1e-04,
  covariance = c("iw", "sigma2R"),
  R_episode = NULL,
  R_field = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  sampling = c("marginal", "joint"),
  keep_draws = TRUE
)

Arguments

pde_para_train

Finite numeric matrix of training parameter inputs.

dt_pde_train

Time-indexed list of training response matrices, with simulator runs in rows and original-grid locations in columns.

Nx, Ny

Positive integer grid dimensions.

F_ls_train

"default" or a list of episode design matrices.

F_ls_test

Unused compatibility argument.

N_people

Population scale recorded in the emulator metadata.

nsam

Positive integer number of posterior coefficient draws.

AR_choice

Autoregressive order, 1 or 2.

episode_window

Number of spatial strips per block; must divide Nx.

gp_tune

Positive range tuning factor.

gp_sigma2, gp_tau2

Positive input/spatial kernel amplitude and nugget.

covariance

"iw" (default) or "sigma2R".

R_episode, R_field

Optional spatial covariance matrices for one block and for the full grid. R_episode defaults to the exponential kernel over the sites of a block. R_field is used only by calibration. Unless it is supplied it is not formed here, since an S x S matrix costs \(O(S^2)\) memory and its check \(O(S^3)\) time; calibration builds the same exponential kernel at the observed sites when it needs it.

seed

Optional local RNG seed. NULL follows the session RNG.

verbose

Whether to report progress.

sampling

"marginal" (default) uses smoothed episode marginals conditional on a shared covariance draw, following Eq. (9) and Algorithm 4. "joint" uses backward conditionals to preserve dependence across episodes.

keep_draws

If TRUE (default), store every coefficient draw. If FALSE (marginal sampling only), store only where each episode's draws start in the random-number stream and regenerate identical draws when prediction or calibration needs them. This removes the largest part of a large emulator's memory at the cost of re-drawing (about the original sampling time per full pass over the draws). Each episode then costs about 2.5 KB instead of its draws, so it pays off once an episode's draws exceed that.

Value

An object of class spDBL_emulator, retaining para_ffbs, res_ffbs, and a complete setup list for prediction and calibration.

See also

emulator_predict(), calibration_prepare()

Examples

data("dt_emulation")
d <- dt_emulation
em <- emulator_learn(d$pde_para_train, d$dt_pde_train, Nx = 10, Ny = 10,
                     nsam = 5, seed = 1)
class(em)
#> [1] "spDBL_emulator"
c(n_train = em$setup$n_train, episodes = em$setup$nT, locations = em$setup$N_sp)
#>   n_train  episodes locations 
#>        40       260       100
